questions.question: What was the risk-adjusted indicator rate for surgical site infections following colon procedures at White Plains Hospital Center in 2014?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nydoh_hospital_acquired_infections.csv')
subset = df[(df['Hospital Name'] == 'White Plains Hospital Center') & (df['Indicator Name'] == 'SSI Colon') & (df['Year'] == 2014)]
result = float(subset['Indicator Value'].iloc[0])

questions.question: Did Richmond University Medical Center have a significantly higher rate than the New York State average for hospital-onset Clostridium difficile infections in 2017?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nydoh_hospital_acquired_infections.csv')
subset = df[(df['Hospital Name'] == 'Richmond University Medical Center') & (df['Indicator Name'] == 'CDI Hospital Onset') & (df['Year'] == 2017)]
comp = subset['Comparison Results'].iloc[0]
result = 'yes' if 'Significantly higher' in str(comp) else 'no'
